en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing an oval-framed photograph of a tall cylindrical stone tower with a conical roof, known as La Torre Verde. The tower stands by a street with a fence, nearby houses, trees, and hills in the background. The word 'TRENTO' appears at the top, and a caption identifying the tower as 'La Torre Verde (Opera Etrusca?)' is printed below the image.
